name: Frost
description:
Uncheck a Condition. If you did, roll Spirit vs Strength against a creature within medium range. On a win, the creature takes 1d8 damage and its speed is reduced by 10 ft for 1 round. On a loss, half damage and no speed reduction.

If the Condition you unchecked was Insecure or Afraid, +1d damage.

Describe the frost.
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

✨: The creature's speed is reduced by an additional 10 ft.

🌞: The creature's speed is reduced to 0.

improvements.name: Blizzard
improvements.description: You may pay double the mana cost to instead choose a point within medium range and roll Spirit vs Strength against each creature within short range of that point, with the same effects on each win or loss.
